resources.string: Tap an area on the map or pick its state from the list. Changes go out together in one notice, at most one every 30 seconds.
Only a pause or an evacuation sounds, and only on phones in the chosen areas. Other phones see the notice in the list, without an alarm.
With no area chosen, the evacuation is for the whole festival.
These fail the checks and can’t be started: %1$s
The area changes not sent yet go out before the evacuation.
The evacuation in force stays: this notice doesn’t end it. Phones with older versions of the app keep only the evacuation and will show this notice only after you withdraw it.
The evacuation in force (%1$s) stays. The new one takes it in: it goes to %2$s, with the plan you choose, and holds at least as long.
The evacuation ends in every area where it is in force. Say so on the radio, on stage and on the screens too.
No phone nearby has confirmed it yet.
The notice didn’t go out: this phone already holds a newer one on the same subject from another console. Try again in a minute.
Your exit, %1$s, is in a closed area. Ask the staff which way to leave.
Your area’s main exit is closed. This is the alternative.
Go to one of the exits below.
The meeting point on the map
Your phone doesn’t know which area you’re in.
Evacuation under way. Tap for what to do.
Evacuation. Your exit is in a closed area: ask the staff.
